bootstrap.difference_direction: positive comparator-minus-full values favor the complete contract

confirmation_evaluation.claim_rule: A pass confirms selective tensor-coherence support only for the frozen BioSR degradation challenge. Orientation distribution remains a safety endpoint, not a v9 superiority endpoint.

selection.selection_rule: Exclude every v7 and v8 F-actin cell, then rank remaining central-directory identifiers with the unchanged v7 SHA-256 selector. Pixel values and endpoint outcomes are forbidden inputs.

scale_conditioned_support.combination_rule: maximum of v7 acquisition QC, physical sampling, mild-perturbation stability, identifiability and v9 scale-conditioned acquisition support
scale_conditioned_support.v7_strong_blur_resolution_margin_role: diagnostic only; it failed to detect stable degradation bias in v8 and is excluded from v9 coherence acceptance
scale_conditioned_support.orientation_distribution_rule: unchanged v7 contract; v9 superiority is not claimed for this family

claim_boundary: Independent-cell confirmation of selective tensor-coherence support under a specified BioSR controlled-degradation challenge. Not biological ground truth, image-restoration accuracy, diagnosis, clinical validity, universal tissue validity or Nature-level external validation by itself.
